files.description: List of file paths or directories to monitor.

new_file_command.description: Shell command to run when a new file appears in a watched directory.

poll_interval.description: Seconds between polling watched directories for new files.

show_file_headers.description: Whether to print the filename header when switching between monitored files.

timestamps.description: Whether to prefix output lines with timestamps.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines to display (limited support in xtail).
